newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss francs ended a very quiet day lower, following German Bunds down amid lack of interest from investors drawn to the stock market.
Dealers said there were no fundamental factors moving the Swiss bond market.
There was some demand for securities with medium-term maturities but longer bonds were neglected.
Swaps rose slightly. Two-year and five-year Swiss franc swaps added one basis point each to 1.82/92 and 2.78/82 percent, respectively. Ten-year swaps were up three basis points at 3.69/79 percent.
Conf futures down 23 basis points at 121.12 pct
Euro Swiss francs down six at 98.56
